**Finding submitted: `missing` (TRANSITION), confidence 0.86**

**What I checked**
- Article XXI "Effect of Termination" (p0138) — the only exit clause, and it runs one way: our licence ends and *we* must ship back all Licensed Technology, API documentation and Confidential Information within five days, with officer certification.
- Searches for transition / migration / export / data return / deletion — no hits beyond export-control (p0148) and liability carve-outs (p0130, p0142).
- General Provisions (sec-p0144) and the Confidentiality article (p0123–p0125) — no exit mechanics; the confidentiality obligation binds only the Licensee, so there is no route to recover our own materials.

**Conclusion**
Nothing in the agreement obliges SFG/E-Path FX to help us migrate off the platform or to return our market data and trade records — and nothing restrains it from deleting them. That fails even the fallback (90 days' assistance, export within 30 days) and edges into walk-away territory for a hosted trading platform.

**Redline (validated ok:true)** — new Article XXI(c) inserted after p0138 at the preferred position:
- (i) up to six months' reasonable transition assistance at Licensor's then-current rates, at our request;
- (ii) return of Licensee Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format within 30 days (with an inline definition, since "Customer Data" is undefined in this agreement);
- (iii) deletion thereafter, certified in writing.

The comment flags the 90-day assistance fallback as a landing zone if six months meets resistance.
